causal.kicker.text: Causal web · drag to pan, scroll to zoom
causal.kicker.note: Small heading above the page title; the view is a graph of events linked by cause and effect

causal.title.note: Page title: the graph of events linked by cause and effect

causal.loading.note: Loading message while the graph loads; the interface adds an ellipsis

causal.type.triggers.note: Legend: a link where one event directly causes another

causal.type.fulfills_prophecy.note: Legend: a link where an event fulfils an earlier prophecy

causal.type.retaliates_for.note: Legend: a link where an event is revenge for an earlier one

causal.type.enables.note: Legend: a link where one event makes another possible

causal.type.deferred_by.note: Legend: a link where one event postpones another

causal.isolated.note: Toggle chip: also show events with no causal links

causal.clear_focus.note: Chip: stop highlighting the chain of the selected event

causal.overlap.note: Label on a link when the cause and effect overlap in time, shown instead of the time between them

causal.focus.note: Panel title: details of the selected event

causal.open_chronicle.note: Button: show this event on the timeline; Chronicle is the name of the timeline view
